title: Courier with a letter
note: D-139. A delivery along the route: the letter pays its fee once, at any terminal or shopkeeper's counter in the city ahead.
notice: A courier is waving travellers down.
openings: Chain snapped, and this has to reach {city} today. The fee's paid already; it goes to whoever brings it in. Will you take it?
You're going to {city}? Then you can do me a kindness and earn the delivery fee. One letter, sealed, any terminal there will take it.

choices.label: I'll take it to {city}
choices.reply: Bless you. Any terminal or shop counter in {city} will take it and pay the fee. Don't open it.

choices.label: Why not take it yourself?
choices.reply: My chain snapped and the depot shuts at dusk. The fee is the same whoever carries it.
